push.title: D 2-2 vs Scentless | You: 8.3 (4th best match performance)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, your 4th best match performance at 8.3. Good as gold.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at Scentless's goal. You weren't shy, and shy doesn't score.
+ 0.6 above average. Growth looks good on you.
+ Tackle success 33%, up from your usual 12%. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.
+ Passes attempted 28, from 1 in your previous match. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.
+ 2-2 with Scentless. We'll sharpen the edges.

THE BAD
- 71% passing (20 of 28). Training homework: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. For next time: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.
- Shots on target: 80%. A good number on the way to 90%+.

Try this in practice: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.

Last thing, PhogsToffees. The ball doesn't know your rating. Neither should your attitude.

Thanks for making it look easy. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 2-2 vs Scentless | You: 7.1 (2nd worst match performance)
push.body:
A 7.1, BellyTb1. Breathe. We'll look at the tape, find one thing, and fix it.

THE GOOD
+ 94% passing on 16 attempts, up from your usual 73%. That's the kind of passing that tires the other team out.
+ 1 assist. Your passes had GPS and good manners.
+ You and PhogsToffees combined like peanut butter and banana. Underrated and delicious.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 1. That's what showing up looks like.
+ Level, 2-2, with Scentless. Learn from it and move on.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Mind this: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- That 7.1 sits as your 2nd worst match performance. Next one's the bounce-back.
- Shots on target 0, down from your usual 2. Easy win: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.
- Their humans averaged 24 completed passes; you had 15. Fixable, but only if we fix it.

Warm-up idea: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.

BellyTb1, write this on your hand if you have to: You're not behind; you're just early to your comeback.

Shake it off and lace up. - Coach Lasso
